# OpenLife

> OpenLife is an open-source productivity, time tracking, habit reflection, and workflow analysis web app.

OpenLife helps people plan realistic days, protect focus time, review how they spend time, and improve daily workflows. The project is intentionally beginner-friendly and welcomes focused code, design, testing, and documentation contributions.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://www.openlife.in/): Product overview and daily workflow tools.
- [About](https://www.openlife.in/about): Project purpose, vision, and open-source philosophy.
- [Daily Planner](https://www.openlife.in/planner): Plan focus blocks, routines, and recovery time.
- [Productivity Insights](https://www.openlife.in/insights): Review focus trends and daily balance.
- [Contribute](https://www.openlife.in/contribute): Contribution workflow and beginner guidance.
- [Contributor Hub](https://www.openlife.in/contributor-hub): Scoped work and project resources.
- [Source code](https://github.com/BhupinderSehjal/OpenLife): OpenLife repository on GitHub.
